title: IFRA to present the 52 nd Amendment at Global Cosmetics Regulations 2026
summary: Two scientific experts from the International Fragrance Association ( IFRA ) will present the 52 nd Amendment to the IFRA Standards at Global Cosmetics Regulations 2026 , a virtual conference organized by Chemical Watch on Tuesday, 24 November 2026 .
